Question 8

Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for t∈(−∞,∞), generate the horizontal parabola given by the Cartesian equation y2=12x?

a
x=6t2,y=6t
b
x=3t2,y=6t
c
x=3t2,y=3t
d
x=3t,y=6t2
e
